title: File server share almost full
symptom: A shared drive on the file server is nearly out of space
user_description: The finance share is at 97 percent. People are already getting save errors. Can you free some space quickly?

options.text: Delete the largest folders to free space quickly
options.why: Deleting without checking can destroy important records. Large folders are often large because they matter.

options.text: Delete everything older than a year
options.why: Age alone does not show that data is unneeded. Finance records may need to be kept for years by law or policy.

options.text: Find what is using the space, check with the data owners and retention policy before removing anything, archive or clean up with approval, and consider quotas
options.why: A safe fix finds the cause, gets permission, and prevents it happening again. Archiving or quotas solve the problem for good instead of just delaying it.

options.text: Move the extra files to a personal USB drive
options.why: Takes company data outside company control and creates a security and compliance risk.

hints: Do you know what is using the space?
Who decides which files can be deleted?
How could you stop the share filling up again?
real_world_tip: Use the file server's storage reports or a disk usage tool to see which folders and file types are largest. Duplicates and old backups are common culprits.
